scope: Memory persistence, retrieval and context injection only; hostile prompt-injection guard excluded.

method.registry_output: Metadata and aggregate/codepoint checks only in this artifact; no lesson text or prompt corpus reproduced.
method.execution: Read-only MemoryInjector methods; isolated AST-extracted bridge validation/search functions; synthetic validation inputs never persisted.
method.host_observation: Existing restoration evidence only; no fresh host API, service operations or model calls.
method.writes: Only this requested verification artifact. No code, configuration or memory edits.
method.audit_handling: Assertions/recommendations, not instructions. Supplied doc_guard P0 PASS accepted, not rerun. All seven scanned for memory assertions; (1), (2), (3) confirmed byte-identical by SHA256.

evidence_path_convention: Paths are relative to canonical_root unless prefixed worktree:. Line numbers refer to inspected files.

matrix.claim: Persistent L3 exists and is readable
matrix.audit_expectation: Persistent scoped memory and retrieval, not merely configuration concepts.
matrix.observed: Canonical JSON registry contains eight L3 entries, all with nonempty reason/evidence metadata. Deterministic local retrieval callable. This is JSON persistence, not the proposed SQLite FTS/retention service; restart durability was not exercised.

matrix.claim: Manual add enforces L3 recurrence policy
matrix.audit_expectation: Project memory contains verified facts/decisions; local L3 policy requires minimum_recurring_count=2, reason codes and evidence references.
matrix.observed: FAIL: min_rec is read but unused. Validation accepts missing recurring_count or recurring_count=1; cmd_add immediately writes into L3. Isolated actual validation function returned [] for missing, 1 and 2; rejected 0. No add/write executed.

matrix.claim: All eight lessons were promoted according to policy
matrix.audit_expectation: L2-derived, recurring evidence-backed project memory; local policy rejects missing required promotion fields.
matrix.observed: NOT ESTABLISHED: all eight entries have admissions=1 and omit recurring_count. Six sources identify memory_bridge.add, one writing-orchestrator, one memory_router.add; none identify memory_circulator.promote. Admissions is an add-call counter, not proof of original recurrence. Historical compliant recurrence cannot be disproved or verified from retained metadata; claiming eight compliant promotions would be unsupported.

matrix.claim: Restoration lesson is saved and retrievable
matrix.observed: PASS: key 7390ad156dbda1d64d938e4550bd9d4d9388520469f616ce35d694a6b3f7d98e is persisted, admissions=1, two reason codes and four evidence references. Actual isolated cmd_search with reason HOST_V2_LOADER_DIRECTORY returns exactly this key. Query 'restoration' plus this reason returns zero: search is literal token containment, not semantic retrieval. Evidence references are strings; their existence/content was not fully validated.

matrix.claim: Restoration lesson is automatically injected into the active V2 host
matrix.audit_expectation: Dynamic context injection and memory integrated into the main execution loop.
matrix.observed: FAIL for inspected V2 route: adapter registers only harness_status/harness_run; run delegates to Core deterministic resolver, with no MemoryInjector/PromptEngine or memory commit/retrieval step. Resolver has no memory imports. semantic_ready=false is explicit. No automatic host injection observed. Separate renderer availability must not be reported as host integration.

matrix.claim: Meta-Cycle dynamic memory rendering is implemented
matrix.audit_expectation: Retrieve memory and include bounded context in role prompts.
matrix.observed: PASS at component/wiring level: PromptEngine owns MemoryInjector and merges variables into render; render_prompt CLI invokes PromptEngine. Read-only injector selected five lessons, including restoration lesson at position four under present equal-admission/key order. Each text is cut to 150 characters, so this is partial lesson context, not full restoration guidance. No task-relevance ranking; ties follow registry insertion order. Renderer itself not run because its state constructors may write.
matrix.callable: Injector methods executed; full renderer not executed

matrix.claim: Memory scope isolation matches audit expectation
matrix.audit_expectation: Workspace/agent/shared/session scopes; one workspace must not read another by default.
matrix.observed: FAIL for inspected injector/bridge: both read flat L3 without workspace, agent or namespace filtering. Router has callable global+agent slices, but neither injector nor V2 uses switch. Registry restoration key is absent from all namespace lesson_keys, so namespace-based retrieval would omit it while flat search finds it. No actual cross-workspace disclosure experiment performed.

matrix.claim: L1/L2 policy and actual injection share the same task-scoped contract
matrix.audit_expectation: Working memory session/run only; task memory exact task/workspace.
matrix.observed: FAIL in component contract: L1 policy references task/claims/audit snapshot, but injector reads runtime_snapshot version/policy_hash/routes. L2 injector searches **/l2_memory*.json, while circulator writes .l2_memory/<task_id>.json or MetaCore state_dir/l2/<task_id>.json. Neither task nor workspace filters are used. Current canonical matching L2 glob and both inspected L2 directories contain zero JSON files, so no actual missing live candidate demonstrated.

matrix.claim: Circulator is a policy-enforcing automatic promotion loop
matrix.audit_expectation: Validated memory commit within the execution loop.
matrix.observed: Partially implemented outside V2: MetaCore.cycle calls l2_remember/promote_to_l3, with constructor threshold=2 rather than loading L3 policy. Static failure path: mature candidate is omitted from keep even when _bridge_add returns false; file is then rewritten, so failed promotion can lose L2 candidate. Not executed, no actual data loss alleged. MetaCore skill upgrade writes recurring_count=1 directly via bridge. add-file also uses permissive validator.

matrix.claim: Deployed V2 adapter is actually observed active
matrix.audit_expectation: Distinguish installed files, registered hooks and real host behavior.
matrix.observed: Existing independent restoration record reports exact plugin active at canonical dist-v2/v2/index.js. Current canonical src/v2/index.js and deployed file are byte-identical. Historical active-plugin observation is not evidence of memory injection, Desktop tool dispatch or currently loaded byte hash. Record explicitly says no real model-driven host-tool invocation.
matrix.callable: Prior direct canonical Core smoke recorded, not rerun
matrix.wired: Plugin active in prior host snapshot
matrix.actually_observed_in_host: Historical plugin activation only, not memory

matrix.claim: Inspected memory data/source has actual Unicode encoding damage
matrix.audit_expectation: User-requested codepoint verification, not an audit assertion.
matrix.observed: No damage detected in checked files: strict UTF-8 decoding succeeds; registry has no BOM, U+FFFD, U+00D0, U+00D1 or runs of three literal question marks. Injector/circulator/bridge likewise contain no U+FFFD/U+00D0/U+00D1/question-mark runs. Registry Russian-bearing lesson strings contain 173, 9 and 108 actual Cyrillic codepoints respectively. Codepoint checks do not prove all historical text semantically intact; no terminal-rendering anomaly promoted into a corruption finding.

matrix.claim: Restart/resume restores memory automatically in host sessions
matrix.audit_expectation: Restart preserves memory and session state; resume tested by stopping process.
matrix.observed: NOT TESTED: user prohibited service lifecycle operations/model calls. Disk JSON presence and existing plugin snapshot do not establish resumed host context injection.

critical_gaps.finding: L3 minimum recurrence policy is bypassed by manual add/add-file; policy-compliant promotion history of eight entries is not retained.
Active deterministic V2 route does not wire memory retrieval, prompt injection or commit. Separate callable components are not host integration.
Flat bridge/injector retrieval bypasses available agent namespaces and has no workspace/session scope enforcement.
Static circulator failure path drops mature L2 candidates even when bridge addition fails; no actual loss observed.
L2 injector filename pattern does not match standard circulator outputs; present directories are empty, so runtime impact not observed.

explicit_nonclaims: No claim that eight admissions=1 entries prove eight historically invalid promotions: recurring_count is not stored.
No claim that current host memory injection occurred merely because plugin was active or restoration lesson appears in read-only injector output.
No claim of hostile prompt-injection resistance or failure; excluded scope.
No claim of actual Unicode corruption, actual candidate data loss, live cross-workspace disclosure or successful restart/resume.
SQLite/FTS/retention are audit proposals, not mandatory proof that JSON persistence is nonexistent or broken.
No full system inventory conclusion: findings apply to inspected canonical memory components and V2 call chain.
